unlisted_practices: Regulators should monitor the evolution of each adaptive ML system over time and conduct postmarket surveillance of its performance, errors, and instances of patient harm.
Regulators should monitor each site-specific copy of an adaptive ML system for divergence between copies.

Manufacturers should consider federated learning to eliminate synchronic variation between copies of an adaptive ML system, weighing the trade-off between generalizability and local performance for particular patient cohorts.

screen.reason: Tutorial and ethical perspective/commentary highlighting ethical challenges and governance considerations for adaptive/continual-learning ML systems in clinical settings.
